native_outcome.reason: F1 incorrectly assigned transition rate N^2 to equal-occupation swaps. The model assigns that rate only to occupation-changing swaps. Such unchanged swaps have zero observable increment, so extending the generator and squared-jump sums to all bonds is valid; the martingale, bracket formula and bound remain correct. Corrected F1 and made this zero-increment extension explicit.

changed_current_paragraphs: [F1] [[def-csm-frontier-ssep-diffusive-model]]: $\Omega_N$ is finite; each occupation-changing unordered nearest-neighbor swap has rate $N^2$. Equal endpoint occupations give no off-diagonal transition and zero observable increment, so generator and squared-jump sums may be extended over all bonds with coefficient $N^2$. Also $\pi_t^N=N^{-d}\sum_x\eta_x(t)\delta_{x/N}$ and $\langle\pi,G\rangle=N^{-d}\sum_x\eta_xG(x/N)$.
